sources.scrape_note: Both primary roofing-library references are already codified in-repo: owlroofing.com is the reference behind astro-templates/owl (section order, dark bands, signature system, numbered process) and firefly-cd.vercel.app behind astro-templates/firefly. Per the library's note_url_fragility guidance, the template directory was used as the structural source of truth instead of re-scraping. Saved ~$0.04 of Firecrawl spend with no loss of fidelity.
sources.brand_tokens_from: sites/eastern-residential-solutions/intake-scraped.json (Firecrawl branding extraction of the client homepage)

palette_rationale.accent: #D90916 is the client's authentic brand red, detected from their primary CTA button. Kept verbatim — it is the color on their logo, their Get Quote button, and their service cards.
palette_rationale.primary: #0A1622 is their navy #2C506E driven down to a deep navy-black so it works as the template's dark band. At #2C506E the brand red measured 1.61:1 against it and was unreadable; at #0A1622 it clears 3.48:1, which beats the owl template's own default accent-on-primary ratio of 3.77:1's neighborhood and passes the 3:1 non-text / large-text threshold the dark-band eyebrows and star rows need.
palette_rationale.accent_ink: #B00711 is the red darkened for use as foreground text on the light background (eyebrows, tick marks, stars, chevrons), measuring 6.78:1 on --color-bg.
palette_rationale.bg: Cool neutral off-white rather than owl's default warm #f7f5f0 — a warm cream fights a red-and-navy brand.
palette_rationale.rejected: #0000EE was detected in the client's CSS but is the browser default link blue on unstyled anchors, not a brand color. Discarded.

typography.rationale: Oswald is the client's actual heading typeface, detected on their live site — condensed, industrial, and a good match for a roofing brand, so it carries brand continuity into the rebuild. Their detected body-role face, Playfair Display, is a serif display type unsuited to running body copy and was rejected in favor of the owl template default, Inter.

section_styling_hints: Fixed owl section order — hero with full-bleed photo and floating quote card, promise bar, services grid with category labels and sub-service lists, testimonials on the dark band, promise band, signature system, 4-step numbered process on a dark band, about with checklist, long-form SEO body with a second checklist, FAQ, recent articles, closing CTA.
Squared corners lean into the brand: the client's own buttons are pill-shaped but their logo and badge lockups are hard-edged; the owl 4px/8px radius scale is retained rather than adopting the pill.
Real project photography from the client's own portfolio throughout — no stock. Every gallery image is a documented NEPA job.
avoid: generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats, generic hard-hat closeup)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
cartoon or licensed-character mascots — the current site places a Pink Panther graphic beside the Owens Corning badge, which undercuts the credential
white body text on saturated red panels at small sizes — the current site's service cards do this and it is uncomfortable to read
overlapping nav badge/label strips that clip their own text, as on the current homepage icon row
run-on county lists as a substitute for real service-area pages
off-site third-party legal pages — the current site points Privacy and Terms at thebasalygagroup.com
